HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.
   C. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

5. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   B. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

7. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   C. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.
   B. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.
   D. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.
   D. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.
   B. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   D. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   B. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
